mercadolibreTemplates.descriptionTemplate:
Kids' T-Shirt 100% Cotton - Premium Quality
Give your little ones ultimate comfort and style with our high-quality cotton kids tee! Created with the softness children need for their daily adventures, this garment delivers long-lasting wear, breathability and a relaxed, comfortable fit.
Why choose our kids’ t-shirt?
● 100% Pure Cotton: Feel the unbeatable softness of natural cotton. Our tee features premium fabric, excellent air permeability and hypoallergenic material that is gentle on children’s skin, perfect for everyday wear.
● Premium Grade Fabric: Pure cotton keeps kids cool in summer and cozy all year round.
● Built to Last: Made to stand up to kids’ active lifestyles and frequent washing, the fabric stays in great condition without fading or deforming.
● Relaxed Comfort Fit: Versatile loose cut, ideal for playing, school activities and sports.
● Customizable Design: Support custom printing patterns and multiple clothing color options, you can create exclusive styles for your kids.
Fast Shipping Promise
We know you want your order as soon as possible! We guarantee your order will be shipped out within 24 hours after payment confirmation.
Satisfaction Guarantee
● 30-Day Manufacturer Warranty: We stand fully behind the quality of our products.
● Buyer Protection: Get exactly what you ordered, or we’ll refund your payment.
● Free Returns: You have 30 days after receiving the item to request exchanges or full refunds.
SIZE GUIDE (Measurements in CM)
To pick the perfect size, measure a well-fitting t-shirt your child already owns and compare it to our size chart below:
Size 100: Length 41 cm | Bust 32 cm | Height 100 cm | Weight 10–15 kg
Size 110: Length 44 cm | Bust 34 cm | Height 110 cm | Weight 15–17.5 kg
Size 120: Length 47 cm | Bust 36 cm | Height 120 cm | Weight 17.5–22.5 kg
Size 130: Length 50 cm | Bust 38 cm | Height 130 cm | Weight 22.5–27.5 kg
Size 140: Length 53 cm | Bust 40 cm | Height 140 cm | Weight 27.5–32.5 kg
Size 150: Length 57 cm | Bust 42 cm | Height 150 cm | Weight 32.5–40 kg
Size 160: Length 60 cm | Bust 44 cm | Height 160 cm | Weight 40–50 kg
Note: All measurements are taken manually, a slight deviation of 1–2 cm may occur.
